facts.fact: African Capital Markets News reports that Ethio Telecom has registered 22m of the 32m citizens enrolled nationwide in the Fayda National ID, nearly half of them between July and December 2025.

facts.fact: The article says 58.6m Ethiopians use Ethio Telecom's telebirr mobile payment service, with ETB 1.9 trillion in electronic money transfers in the six months to December 2025.
